title: CDC - Preventing Chronic Disease: General Guidelines
content: Peer Review Checklists Print Minus Related Pages We require peer reviewers to complete their evaluations electronically on ScholarOne Manuscripts . The Reviewer’s Confidential Manuscript Assessment for the Editor shows what peer reviewers will see when they log in to review manuscripts on ScholarOne Manuscripts. The manuscript assessment form is available on this page as a downloadable PDF document for informational purposes only . Please follow these instructions to download the form: Click the following link to download the form: Manuscript Assessment [PDF – 112K] . Save the form onto your desktop or hard drive. Open the form to view or print. In addition, please see the manuscript checklists highlighted below. We do not require reviewers to use these checklists, but we encourage reviewers (as well as authors) to use them as guides for evaluating manuscripts. They are available for your convenience below, and they are also available through ScholarOne Manuscripts.
